intended_object: The comparison (trichotomy) function on Cantor-normal-form ordinal notations below ε₀: ω^e₁·n₁+a₁ vs ω^e₂·n₂+a₂ compared lexicographically by exponent, coefficient, then tail, with 0 least (from the docstring).
explanation: The definition implements exactly the lexicographic comparison described in the docstring. It handles the base cases with 0 and, for oadd terms, chains the recursive comparison of exponents, the ℕ comparison of coefficients and the recursive comparison of tails via Ordering.then. On normal-form notations this agrees with the order of the represented ordinals, as Mathlib proves in this file (e.g. cmp_compares). It is intrinsic to this specific notation system, so no generality issue arises.
